gates.name: .NET build and tests
gates.command: dotnet restore; dotnet build --no-restore --configuration Release; dotnet test --no-build --configuration Release --verbosity normal

gates.name: Game-service suite
gates.command: npm install; npm run typecheck; npm test

gates.name: Documentation build and site check
gates.command: ./docs.ps1 -BuildOnly; npm --prefix site ci; npm --prefix site run check
